open_points.subject: start_instance listener-open failure handling
open_points.text: when the DiscardResult's removed is false, says that the new store was left with the step of = models.DiscardStep and the kind of = models.DiscardFailureKind its failure names
open_points.other_text: DiscardResult fields (exact, no others exist): failure: DiscardFailure | None, removed: bool
open_points.question: Must failure be guaranteed non-None whenever removed is false, or must the diagnostic requirement define behavior for removed false with failure equal to None?

open_points.subject: start_instance request-header decoding note
open_points.text: each header field's value its bytes read as UTF-8 with every byte that is not part of a valid sequence replaced by U+FFFD
open_points.rule:
Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов. Значение размещается процедурой 15.2 и доходит до кода одним из трёх путей §15.3.1; note называет
  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus` (член — его именем рядом с адресом, §15.3.1),
  константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The encoding and invalid-sequence replacement policy must be placed in an imported provider constant, settings field, or appropriate model enumeration and named through that permitted path instead of being supplied inline.
